$comment: Review rules for Architecture review (BASITA-150). Read from the base branch, so a PR cannot change its own rules; a change to this file is itself critical. Patterns are Python regular expressions on repo-relative paths, joined with |.

architecture_review.$comment_reviewer_own_bots: BASITA-161: the reviewer's approval never counts on a PR that one of these bots opened or committed to; the check then waits for the owner.
architecture_review.$comment_t4: BASITA-161, plan 10.10: what the T4 fire step may start when the repo variable T4_FIRE is dry-run or on. Only PRs opened by agent_bots from this repo; at most max_rework_rounds reworks. Routine names map to the secrets ROUTINE_FIRE_<NAME> and the trigger ids in the variable T4_ROUTINES.
